identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SHR6508 in Secondary Hyperparathyroidism
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Randomized, Active-Controlled Dose Titration Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of SHR6508 in Hemodialysis Subjects With Secondary Hyperparathyroidism

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SHR6508 for Chinese patients with secondary hyperparathyroidism of chronic kidney disease treated by maintenance hemodialysis.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in serum iPTH
primaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline and the efficacy period, defined as Week 16

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Participants to End of Study whose iPTH decreased by≥30% from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline and the efficacy period, defined as Week 16

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Participants to End of Study whose iPTH decreased to 300 pg/mL from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: iPTH was tested at a central laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline and the efficacy period, defined as Week 16

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in serum cCa and P
secondaryOutcomes.description: cCa and P were tested at a local laboratory.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline and the efficacy period, defined as Week 16

secondaryOutcomes.description: Terms were coded with Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 to End of Study, End of Study is about Week 20

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participants with Anti-SHR6508 Antibody at baseline and postbaseline
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Day1 to End of Study, End of Study is about Week 20

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Able and willing to provide a written informed consent
2. Diagnosed with end stage renal disease receiving stable hemodialysis
3. Male or female
4. Meet the Body Mass Index standard
5. Stably use of concomitant medication of other therapies of SHPT
6. Meet the standard of iPTH level, cCa and HB

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Subjects with a history of malignant tumor
2. Subjects with neuropsychiatric diseases
3. Subjects with a history of cardiovascular diseases
4. Subjects with gastrointestinal diseases
5. Subjects with a history of surgery
6. Subjects with a history of blood loss
7. Subjects with a history of kidney transplant
8. Abnormal blood pressure, serum magnesium, serum transaminase, serum albumin
9. Subjects with a treatment history of similar drugs
10. Allergic to a drug ingredient or component
11. Pregnant or nursing women
12. No birth control during the specified period of time
13. Subject with a history of alcohol abuse and drug abuse
14. Participated in clinical trials of other drugs
15. The investigators determined that other conditions were inappropriate for participation in this clinical trial
